_comment: Named helmet presets (head armor). Character Law rows carry book cost/weight/production time (Armor Price Chart 118-124, weight midpoints). Arms Companion 5.4 types carry book descriptions only; cost/weight come from the armor composer (cost/weight null = composer values). AT comes from the mapped material; APAC (5.2) prices the head area off that AT. HELMET CHART (Arms Companion p.38): dfHead/dfBody are the Defense Factor shifts; dfBody feeds DB only when the helmets armor type differs from the worn ATs type (dfHalfSameType items apply half even then); dfNeckOnly marks Head DF that protects the neck only. pf is the Perception Factor; ef the Exhaustion Factor (data only).

helmets.name: Full Helm
helmets.notes: Covers neck and face; has vent slits.

helmets.name: Aventail
helmets.notes: Chain neck armor; attaches to helm.

helmets.name: Arming Cap
helmets.notes: A thick cloth cap worn over the entire head, not covering the face and neck.

helmets.name: Coif
helmets.notes: Chain head piece covering the entire head and part of neck. It does not cover face, and is usually worn beneath heavier helms.

helmets.name: Spangan Helm
helmets.notes: A metal bowl shaped helm that covers the top of the head down to the brow and ears. It is strapped or buckled under chin.

helmets.name: Spangan Helm with Nasal
helmets.notes: As the Spangan Helm, but has a metal strip protruding from above the brow that covers the nose and top of the mouth.

helmets.name: Sallet
helmets.notes: As the Spangan, but covers the back and sides of the head. It has disks shielding the ears. The top of the helm is pointed, protecting the head better. This has no facial covering.

helmets.name: Sallet and Beaver
helmets.notes: As above, except it has a mobile plate that can cover the face and chin. This plate can be pushed above the brow.

helmets.name: Gorget
helmets.notes: This is a plate ring that sits on the shoulders and covers the neck. It is attached to neither the helm nor the shoulder plates of armor.

helmets.name: Lobster Tail
helmets.notes: A full helm with head, neck and partial face covering. The neck and sides are protected by connecting plates. The face has three thin slats, one over the nose and the others beside the eyes and over the cheeks.
